# A NASDAQ:MSFT price in a file that declares no such commodity, imported into
# a book that has none.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing; the refusal, which prints NASDAQ:MSFT.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_file_of_prices_imports_on_its_own.py.
price
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "MSFT"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	time: "2026-01-06 21:00:00 +0000"
	value: "423.10"
	source: "Finance::Quote"
	type: "last"
